name: Morgan Le Fay
subtitle: Fae Sorceress
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Ambitious half-sister of Arthur, rival of Merlin, Morgan le Fay stands among Avalon’s most potent sorcerers. Between her magics and her many plots, she has nearly overthrown Camelot countless times, and even the Shattering has not blunted her efforts. Her most intricate plan has her cooperating with Koshchei the Deathless across realms, but even this represents but one of many ongoing schemes.

leader_bonus.text: Increase Cunning Ally ACC by 25 and ATK by 25%

divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when placing a [Debuff] on an enemy.

skills.name: Spellbook of Corruption
skills.description: Attack all enemies (50%ATK+400%ACC)3 times. Each hit has a 50% chance to place at random [mechanic:aetherburn-ii], [mechanic:blaze-ii], [mechanic:acid] on the target for 2 turns, or 1 stack of [mechanic:bleed].

skills.name: Dark Magicks
skills.description: Attack all enemies (150%ATK+1000%ACC) with a 35% chance to place [mechanic:vulnerable-ii] on each target for 2 turns. Then activate a random [Debuff] on each target.

skills.name: Ruin of Avalon
skills.description:
Before attacking remove all [mechanic:aetherburn], [mechanic:bleed] stacks, [mechanic:acid] and [mechanic:blaze] from all enemies, then attack all enemies (200%ATK+1200%ACC).
For every 5[Debuffs] removed, increase the damage dealt by 25%. If 20 or more [Debuffs] were removed, increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 100%.
